Transforming the Delivery of Modern Healthcare

Universal Health Services, Inc. (UHS) is one of the largest and most respected providers of hospital and healthcare services in the nation with more than 101,500 employees dedicated to improving people’s lives and transforming the delivery of healthcare. Through its subsidiaries, the company operates 30 Acute Care hospitals , more than 380 Behavioral Health inpatient facilities , 35 freestanding emergency departments and more than 130 outpatient facilities and ambulatory care centers in 40 states in the U.S., Washington, D.C., Puerto Rico, Ireland and the United Kingdom. UHS Inc. subsidiary Talkspace has virtual behavioral health services throughout the United States and Puerto Rico. Prominence Health offers health plans and provider support, and Independence Physician Management develops and manages physician services and urgent care centers.

raw_blocks: Universal Health Services, Inc. (UHS) is one of the nation’s largest and most respected providers of hospital and healthcare services.
Transforming the Delivery of Modern Healthcare

UHS operates through its subsidiaries more than 540 acute care hospitals, behavioral health facilities, freestanding emergency departments and ambulatory centers. As we continue to expand our business, we’ll stay focused on making healthcare a positive, more local experience. UHS also offers health insurance and Medicare plans through its subsidiary, Prominence Health. And we manage a vast network of doctors and providers through Independence Physician Management, all committed to making a profound impact on the communities we serve.
Quality and Innovation in Everything We Do
With an unwavering commitment to excellence, the UHS Acute Care division aims to raise the bar in quality patient care and transform the patient experience. >>
Our facilities are dedicated to serving patients and their families with empathetic, effective care based on proven therapies that result in successful, long-term recovery. >>
IPM, a subsidiary of UHS, develops and manages specialty physician networks and urgent care centers which align with our acute care and behavioral health facilities. >>
Operating in Florida, Texas and Nevada, Prominence Health Plan members can compare drug prices, view their own medical history, find a provider and take advantage of telehealth appointments. >>
Healthcare Management and Consulting Services
We offer advanced software and consulting services in operational, financial and clinical environments. >>

Since we opened the first acute care hospital in 1979, our vision has been to put patients first. We offer the highest quality patient care at a reasonable cost, and we build relationships with people and the communities we serve.
Alan B. Miller Universal Health Services Founder and Executive Chairman of the Board
